faces.transcription: Remove all Pursuit and Checkpoint tokens from the board.
faces.flavor: Cooper is missing once again, and you suspect he won't be found. Of Sabik, there is no further news. He has disappeared into hiding, but you receive a message. It reads, "I have a few other things to take care of, but don't worry. I haven't forgotten about you."
